subject: [hw] K02 -> D01: hardware facts for FACTS.md (VENC/VDEC power, SMI parents, windows, IRQ)
body:
From gpu/hwcodec/kern/VCODEC_HW.md (every number there carries file:line). All [V] unless marked. Nothing run on the phone by me; the boot-log item is opus-kern's q10hw1 dump.

[V] 1. VENC/VENC_C1 user-visible register windows are 0x3000 bytes: vpud mmaps 0x3000 (host/PROGRESS.md:111-117); dts venc@17000000 reg lists 0x2000, but the VCU node allows 0x17020000+0x10000 (mt6893.dts:6217) and 0x17020000+0x3000 stays below JPGENC 0x17030000. The frozen header comment still says 0x2000 (asked lead for a comment fix).
[V] 2. SMI parents (smi_drv.c:198-232): larb7 (VENC core 0) and larb5 (VDEC SOC/LAT) hang off the DISP common 0x1411f000 (smi units 21/24/25); larb8 (VENC core 1) and larb4 (VDEC core) hang off the MDP common 0x1f002000 (units 22/26/27, clocks SCP_SYS_MDP + CLK_MDP_SMI1/2; iommu1 0x1f027000 serves them). Releasing VENC_C1/VDEC_CORE bus protection with MDP off = the camera 27-44 s hang pattern.
[V] 3. MDP power status: SPM 0x10006000 + 0x16c/0x170 bit 19, MDP_PWR_CON 0x34c (clk-mt6885-pg.c:190, :561). Phone boot (runs/q10hw1/00-step0.log): PWR_STATUS 0x10580e03 = MDP(19)+DIS(20) on, VEN/VEN_C1/VDE/VDE2 off, PWR_CON 0x1112.
[V] 4. SMI clock roots: topckgen 0x10000000 CLK_CFG_1 0x020, disp_sel gate bit 7, mdp_sel gate bit 15 (clk-mt6885.c:1693-1702, MUX_GATE_CLR_SET_UPD; pdn bit set = gated). Both must be clear before a video block is powered.
[V] 5. VENC larb NON_SEC_CON bits 16-19 are the MMSRAM route: Linux sets 0xf on ports 5,6,13,14,21,22 (smi_sysram_enable, smi_drv.c:498-524, from mt6885/mtk_vcodec_enc_pm.c:308-317). Not powering MMSRAM, we clear 0xfff01 on larb7/8 (larb4/5 keep 0xff01: only MMU_EN bit 0 + address bits 32+ bits 8-15).
[V] 6. Interrupt registration: ml_install_interrupt_handler keeps ONE handler per CPU (osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c:801-821); a second install on the GPU PE replaces Nord2GPU::irqDispatch. A VENC/VDEC IRQ needs a chained dispatcher, not another install. SPI 308 -> INTID 340; 313 -> 345.
[I] 7. VENC core 1 IRQ status/ack are 0x1782005c/0x17820060 (same IP; Linux only ever uses core 0). VDEC_RACING (0x16004000) belongs to VDEC_CORE.

No action needed if you already have these; the full derivation is in kern/VCODEC_HW.md sections 0-5 and 8.
